page.help: Clean up a channel by deleting many recent messages at once, or lock a channel so members cannot write in it for a while, for example during a spam wave.

adminNote: To use these tools you need the Administrator permission in this server.

field.reasonHelp: Saved with the action, so other staff know why.

purge.title: Purge messages
purge.help: Deletes many recent messages at once. Discord does not allow this for messages older than 14 days, so those are skipped.
purge.amountHelp: From {min} to {max}. The newest messages go first.
purge.fromUserHelp: Only the newest 100 messages are searched.
purge.nothingYet: Nothing is deleted yet: the next page shows what will be deleted, and you confirm there.
purge.badUser: Only from this member: that is not a user ID. Type a name and choose a member, use Find a member, or paste a user ID (17 to 20 digits).
purge.missingPerms: Mewvo is missing {perms} in #{channel}, so it cannot delete messages there. Nothing was changed.

lock.title: Lock a channel
lock.help: Members can still read the channel but can no longer write in it. Roles that have their own permission in that channel, like staff, still can. Unlocking undoes this, so the channel goes back to the permissions of its category (the folder it is in).

locked.title: Locked channels ({count})
locked.help: Channels where members cannot write right now because the channel itself is locked.

confirm.heading: Confirm: delete messages in #{channel}

fromUser.one: Up to {count} of the newest messages from {who} (only the newest 100 are searched)
fromUser.other: Up to {count} of the newest messages from {who} (only the newest 100 are searched)

confirm.effectText: The messages are deleted for good and cannot be brought back. Messages older than 14 days are skipped.

skippedOld.one: {count} message was older than 14 days and skipped.
skippedOld.other: {count} messages were older than 14 days and skipped.
